fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: ItemId of the owning Workspace.

fields.name: ReaderIds
fields.description: IAM user ids that may read the row (server-stamped ACL).

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Name of the project.

fields.name: ClientName
fields.description: Name of the client company.

fields.name: ClientContact
fields.description: Contact person at the client.

fields.name: ClientIndustry
fields.description: Industry of the client.

fields.name: ClientRegion
fields.description: Region of the client.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Lifecycle of the row. One of: active|deleting. Absent counts as active; project.delete sets deleting before the cascade.

fields.name: BusinessHandedOverByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the person who handed Business over, set by the function.

fields.name: Brief
fields.description: Short project brief.

fields.name: NameSuggested
fields.description: True when the name was suggested by the factory.

fields.name: Stage
fields.description: Journey stage. One of: business|sanitization|requirements|scope|board|build|release|paused|abandoned.

fields.name: ResumeTo
fields.description: Stage to resume to after a pause.

fields.name: CurrentScopeVersion
fields.description: Number of the current ScopeVersion.

fields.name: AssigneeUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the assigned person.

fields.name: BusinessHandedOverAt
fields.description: Time Business was handed over.

fields.name: SanitizationCompletedAt
fields.description: Time Product sanitization was completed.

fields.name: RequirementsConfirmedAt
fields.description: Time requirements were confirmed.

fields.name: RequirementsConfirmedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the person who approved the requirements, set by the function.

fields.name: ScopeLockedAt
fields.description: Time the scope was locked.

fields.name: RepoProvider
fields.description: Git provider of the repository.

fields.name: RepoOwner
fields.description: Owner of the repository.

fields.name: RepoName
fields.description: Name of the repository.

fields.name: RepoMode
fields.description: How the repository is set up.

fields.name: RepoVisibility
fields.description: Visibility of the repository.

fields.name: RepoBranch
fields.description: Default branch of the repository.

fields.name: RepoExisting
fields.description: Reference to an existing repository.

fields.name: RepoNameEdited
fields.description: True when the repository name was edited by hand.

fields.name: IsExample
fields.description: True for the example project.

fields.name: SeedKey
fields.description: Stable seed key of an example record.

fields.name: Rev
fields.description: Revision counter for conflict checks.

fields.name: Goal
fields.description: What the product should achieve, from the guided project start.

fields.name: TargetUsers
fields.description: Who the product is for, from the guided project start.

fields.name: AppUrl
fields.description: http(s) address of the running app, from the guided project start.

fields.name: WebsiteUrl
fields.description: Optional http(s) address of the client's official website, from the guided project start (at most 500 characters).

fields.name: LandingPageAddOn
fields.description: The Landing page add-on, JSON {choice:none|new|modify, answers, revision, savedAt, savedByUserId}; written by project.addon.landingPage.save.

fields.name: LandingPageSection
fields.description: The Goals & requirements section 'Add-on: Landing page', JSON {revision, goals, requirements, generatedAt, confirmedAt, confirmedByUserId}; written by the requirements draft and project.addon.landingPage.confirm.

fields.name: TestEnv
fields.description: JSON string {available: yes|no|unsure, url?, accessHow?}: the test environment, from the guided project start.

fields.name: RunInstructions
fields.description: How to run the product, from the guided project start.

fields.name: BlocksProjectRef
fields.description: Product Blocks OS tenant key. Server-owned in automatic Factory provisioning.

fields.name: BlocksStageProjectRef
fields.description: Operator-owned actual Blocks stg tenant ID; never inferred from the dev ID.

fields.name: BlocksProductionProjectRef
fields.description: Operator-owned actual Blocks prod tenant ID; never inferred from the dev ID.

fields.name: BlocksProjectDomain
fields.description: HTTPS development domain assigned by Blocks OS; server-owned.

fields.name: BlocksProvisioningStatus
fields.description: Server-owned provisioning state: pending, creating, ready, needs-reconciliation.

fields.name: BlocksProvisioningName
fields.description: Immutable unique OS project name used to reconcile uncertain CLI creation.

fields.name: BlocksProvisioningAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp of provisioning claim or successful attachment; server-owned.

fields.name: BlocksProvisioningError
fields.description: Safe operator-facing provisioning failure summary; no raw CLI output or credentials.

fields.name: SetupAnswers
fields.description: JSON object string: the guided project start's answers.

fields.name: SetupStatus
fields.description: State of the guided project start: draft or complete.

fields.name: SetupMustHaves
fields.description: JSON array string [{text, priority: must|should|could}]: what the product must do, from the Project setup windows.

fields.name: SetupWorkflows
fields.description: JSON array string of short "who does what" lines, from the Project setup windows.

fields.name: SetupExclusions
fields.description: JSON array string: what the project leaves out, from the Project setup windows.

fields.name: SetupConstraints
fields.description: JSON array string [{kind: deadline|budget|compliance|languages|integrations|other, text}], from the Project setup windows.

fields.name: IntendedChanges
fields.description: Existing product: what should change, in the client's words, from the Project setup windows.

fields.name: IntendedChangeTags
fields.description: Existing product: JSON array string of the picked kinds of change, from the Project setup windows.

fields.name: ApprovalOwnerUserId
fields.description: The workspace member who approves the result (user id), from the Project setup windows.

fields.name: LiveProductJson
fields.description: Snapshot of what product.document read from the live product (JSON, src/domain/liveProduct.ts parseLiveProductSnapshot): repositories, environments with branches, addresses and head commits, modules, release history, what was left empty.

fields.name: ChecksPolicy
fields.description: What the engine does by itself when a change's own checks fail after its deploy, JSON {v:1, autoFixRounds: 0..2, autoRevert} (src/domain/changeChecks.ts checksPolicyOf; absent: 2 rounds, then put development back); written by cr.checksPolicy.

fields.name: ParallelStreams
fields.description: How many independent change requests build side by side, JSON {v:1, chosen: 1..5, suggested: 1..5, reason, by, at} (src/domain/parallelStreams.ts parseStreamsChoice; absent: 1, one build at a time); written by cr.parallelStreams.

fields.name: StreamsAdvice
fields.description: What the engine host allows for parallel streams, JSON {v:1, cap: 1..5, why, repos, at} (src/domain/parallelStreams.ts parseStreamsAdvice): its repositories ready for separate working copies and its environment's limits on check runs; written by the engine (change.analyse, change.build).

fields.name: ContinueIncrements
fields.description: Continue with the next increment of a feature when its checks pass on development, JSON {v:1, on, by, at} (src/domain/continueIncrements.ts parseContinueSetting; absent: off, every increment waits for a person); written by cr.continueIncrements.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key <op>:<requestId>[:<n>], set by the server; unique index.
